cards.card_text: They add that these men are promoting customs that are unlawful 'for us Romans' to adopt or practice.
cards.verse_text: by promoting customs that are unlawful for us Romans to adopt or practice.”

cards.card_text: Even so, Paul says, he was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
cards.verse_text: When they had gathered, he said to them, “Brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or the customs of our fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
cards.snippet: …fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
